ideas.pitch: A Chrome extension and Android wrapper that intercepts real-time smishing and malicious phishing links targeting vulnerable demographics using BERT-based intent analysis.
ideas.title: AegisText AI Phishing & Scam SMS Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles modern cyber threats with a working browser-extension demo, echoing the success pattern of the BERT-powered spam detection system that won runner-up at the Cyber Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered residential energy forecasting dashboard that predicts peak demand intervals and automates smart plug throttling to slash community carbon footprints.
ideas.title: AuraGrid Community Energy Saver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive machine learning models with clear, measurable environmental impact metrics, mirroring the poisson regression forecasting approach that won 1st place at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first medical triage assistant that gives rural communities immediate access to preventive care guidelines, vaccination schedules, and regional outbreak alerts.
ideas.title: MedVoice Rural Health Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses clear social equity and healthcare accessibility gaps for underserved populations, replicating the high-impact multilingual approach of SAGACITY which won first prize at the First Prize Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent workflow copilot that ingests messy corporate unstructured documents, extracts key operational data points, and automatically populates structured project management boards.
ideas.title: TaskFlow Automated Document Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering task automation and demonstrable productivity boosts, matching the video and document intelligence transformation principles seen in LibrAI which won first prize at the Data & Design Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A gamified local mobility app featuring GPS tracking and an AI marketing assistant that directs urban residents toward sustainable local businesses and green spaces.
ideas.title: LocalPulse Community Walk-to-Earn & Eco Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to everyday community practicality by merging civic engagement with functional local business AI tools, following the exact blueprint of the catwalk project that won 1st place at the Chatswood AI Real-World Impact Hackathon.
